```python
def radix_sort(arr):
    max_num = max(arr)
    exp = 1
    while max_num / exp > 0:
        count = [0] * 10
        output = [0] * len(arr)
        for i in range(len(arr)):
            index = (arr[i] / exp) % 10
            count[index] += 1
        for i in range(10):
            count[i] += count[i - 1]
        for i in range(len(arr) - 1, -1, -1):
            index = (arr[i] / exp) % 10
            output[count[index] - 1] = arr[i]
            count[index] -= 1
        for i in range(len(arr)):
            arr[i] = output[i]
        exp *= 10
    return arr
```
